published_evaluation_unit: Mean across 10 manually checked full-frame images
note: The formula is TP/manual count, equivalent to recall. However, the paper used a different set of 10 images.
Our value is calculated only among cells localized by the full-frame workflow on the 13-image released set.
The paper's classifier received reference-aligned cell crops; our matched-cell accuracy follows automatic center detection.
The paper did not report an equivalent end-to-end metric.
